Item Name: ESP32-S3-CAM N16R8 Development Board with OV3660 Camera
Notes: ₹1,175 listed price incl. GST. This combines the ESP32-S3 and camera to fit the budget. It uses OV3660, not the SIH architecture’s IMX219. Verify board pinout and footprint before schematic/PCB work.

Item Name: IP65 Transparent-Top Weatherproof Enclosure, 75 x 50 x 30 mm
Notes: ₹199 listed price. Small prototype enclosure only; check physical fit. Camera and gas sensors need suitable windows/openings and sealed cable entry. Sensor airflow must not be blocked.

Item Name: DHT22 / AM2302 Temperature and Humidity Sensor Module
Notes: Approx. ₹130. Confirm whether the selected module already includes a pull-up resistor; do not duplicate it blindly.

Item Name: MQ-2 Gas and Smoke Sensor Module
Notes: Approx. ₹82. Many MQ-2 breakout boards use 5 V and their analog output may exceed ESP32-S3 ADC limits. Add a verified divider/level interface and check heater current.

Item Name: MQ-135 Air-Quality / Gas Sensor Module
Notes: Approx. ₹112.10 incl. GST. Broad gas-response sensor, not a calibrated PM2.5 measurement. The dedicated GP2Y1010AU0F dust sensor is deferred from this $30-capped version.

Item Name: 0.96-inch SSD1306 OLED Display, 128 x 64, I2C
Notes: Approx. ₹129. Verify supply voltage, pin order, and I2C address before assigning the PCB connector.

Item Name: NEO-6M GPS Module with Antenna
Notes: Budget estimate approx. ₹206. Confirm exact module, antenna, UART pinout, and power requirements before layout.

Item Name: SX1278 RA-02 LoRa Transceiver Module, 433 MHz
Notes: Approx. ₹290. This low-cost 433 MHz module is for prototype LoRa point-to-point testing, not the final India-band IN865-867 LoRaWAN configuration. Verify the radio band and applicable rules before deployment.

Item Name: 3.7 V 2600 mAh 18650 Li-ion Battery Cell
Notes: Approx. ₹120 estimate. Use a reputable cell with suitable protection; verify discharge current and runtime requirements.

Item Name: Single-Cell 18650 Battery Holder
Notes: Approx. ₹20 local-parts estimate. Confirm holder dimensions and polarity.

Item Name: 6 V Mini Solar Panel, 100 mA
Notes: Approx. ₹54. Small educational panel only; this output is not sufficient to assume continuous outdoor operation of the camera board and MQ sensor heaters.

Item Name: CN3065 Solar Li-ion Charging Module (or equivalent)
Notes: ₹70 budget estimate; price/model must be confirmed. Verify battery chemistry, charge voltage/current, cell protection, and solar-panel compatibility before connecting a battery.

Item Name: 5 V Boost Converter Module for Battery Supply
Notes: ₹35 budget estimate. Check peak current and temperature. The power design needs load testing before connecting the camera and MQ heater loads.

Item Name: General-Purpose Prototype PCB / Stripboard
Notes: ₹29 listed price. This is prototype board material, not fabrication of the final routed 2-layer KiCad PCB. Custom PCB manufacturing is not included.

Item Name: 2.54 mm Headers, Jumper Wires and Screw-Terminal Connectors (small lot)
Notes: ₹45 small-quantity estimate. Confirm header gender, pitch, pin count, and terminal type against the selected development board and sensor modules.

Item Name: LED and 220-ohm Resistor Pack (Green, Yellow, Red)
Notes: Approx. ₹93 pack estimate; pack may include extra spares. One current-limiting resistor is required per LED.

Item Name: Resistor Assortment for DHT22 Pull-up and ADC Dividers (10 kΩ, 15 kΩ and related values)
Notes: ₹25 local loose-part estimate. Use a divider for each 5 V sensor analog output if required; verify resistor values against the actual modules and ESP32-S3 ADC limits.

Item Name: 10 kΩ Rotary Potentiometers for Analog Test Inputs
Notes: ₹20 estimate for two bare potentiometers. Useful for bench testing/simulated analog input; MQ sensor modules provide the real sensor signals in the physical setup.

Item Name: 3.3-5 V Active Buzzer Module
Notes: Approx. ₹25 low-cost estimate. Confirm current draw and whether the chosen module can be driven directly or needs a transistor/MOSFET driver.

Item Name: Decoupling Capacitors (100 nF and 10 µF, small set)
Notes: ₹15 loose-component estimate. Place decoupling near suitable supply pins and verify the final schematic.

Item Name: 433 MHz Spring Antenna for RA-02 LoRa Module
Notes: ₹25 estimate. Match antenna frequency/connector to the selected module; do not transmit with an unconnected RF output.
